decisions.reason: A consumer superfood drink mix sits far from the firm's waste-to-energy technology focus and shows no evidence of strong results, so it is the obvious candidate when problemistic search frees resources for the flagship ventures.
The modular plant extensions support the core waste-to-energy systems and cost little to keep offering, so they can stay while results remain uncertain.
WASTX Oil is a publicly launched flagship tied to the firm's identity, and with a hiring firm in a growing industry there is enough slack to carry it while results are still uncertain.
The plastic-to-fuel plant is a flagship central to the firm's strategic direction, and the high R&D intensity of the industry means a long development horizon fits the firm's aspirations.
